Staying as a tourist? Know the 90/180 rule 🇹🇷

▪️ The rule: 90 days in any 180. For many nationalities, tourist stays are limited to 90 days within 180 days.
▪️ Staying longer?: Apply for an ikamet. Apply for a residence permit before your legal stay runs out.
▪️ Overstay: Fines and entry bans. Overstaying can mean a fine and a ban on coming back. Check rules for your passport.
